newsitem.title: USA: XCL Ltd says raises $100 mln in 2 placements.
newsitem.headline: XCL Ltd says raises $100 mln in 2 placements.

text.p: XCL Ltd said Friday it has raised $100 million through two private placements of units, one of which was a senior secured note and the other of which was a preferred stock offering.

The company said the placement consisted of $75 million of 13.5 percent senior secured notes due 2004 with common stock purchase warrants, and $25 million of $8.08 cumulative convertible preferred stock, with common stock purchase warrants.
The company said it expects to close the deals next week.
The company said it priced the private placements through Jefferies & Co Inc, with institutional purchasers.

The company said the funds will be applied to develop and place on production its interest in the Zhao Dong block in the Bohai Bay, China, and to drill additional appraisal and exploration wells this year.
Part of the proceeds from the note offering will be applied to repay existing indebtedness.
The company said note proceeds will be released upon Chinese approval of the C-D Field development plan.
